en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over the city of Pécs from an elevated, tree‑framed vantage point. The foreground has a large tree and bushes, while the middle and background show dense rooftops, church towers, and the outline of Pécs Cathedral's towers on a hill. The back side is divided with Hungarian text, handwriting in pencil, a green Hungarian postage stamp, and a 1915 postmark.
